intro: Lesson 63: Non-fiction: what does it take to keep going? (perseverance). Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

passage.title: Teacher-written article for TGA
paras: We love to believe in natural talent. It is a comforting story: some people are simply born great. But look closely at almost any achievement and you will find years of quiet, unglamorous effort. A pianist's 'gift' is thousands of hours of practice. A scientist's breakthrough follows hundreds of failed experiments. Talent may open the door, but it is perseverance that walks through it, again and again, especially when the room on the other side is hard. The question is not 'Are you gifted?' but 'Will you keep going?'
